name: Door with Athletes glass relief panels, c. 1902–1912 (possibly Lalique's own mansion, Cours Albert 1er, or the Jacques Doucet mansion)
note: Vintage black-and-white photograph of a double door with an iron frame, frosted glass and four moulded glass relief panels of dancing or running nude figures. It looks like Lalique's athlete-theme doors, but I could not confirm which door it shows or whether it is the wrought-iron one.
